definitions.detection: Confusion counts use submitted boolean diagnoses only; missing outputs and infrastructure failures reduce classification coverage and are reported separately.
definitions.root_cause: Fraction of graded positive runs satisfying all must root-cause/mechanism axes; not an invented free-text match or overall outcome score.
definitions.device: Exact deterministic device set, where source truth defines it.
definitions.latency: Agent phase is timed separately from deployment/judging/cleanup; older runs without phase timing remain null.
definitions.cost: Returned agent cost only; judge billing unavailable. No model runs means null metrics.
